Run the flexynesis CLI (training mode)

Source: R/flexynesis.R
run_flexynesis.Rd

Builds and executes a flexynesis training command via conda run, with all internal feature selection disabled by default so pre-filtered data passes through untouched. Output is streamed live; on completion the function checks the log for dropped samples and verifies the expected output files exist.

Usage

run_flexynesis(
  data_path,
  omic_list,
  surv_time,
  surv_event,
  outdir,
  model_class = "DirectPred",
  prefix = "job",
  threads = 10,
  device = "cpu",
  use_cv = TRUE,
  variance_threshold = 0,
  correlation_threshold = 1,
  features_top_percentile = 100,
  features_min = 0,
  subsample = 0,
  finetuning_samples = 0,
  feature_importance_method = c("IntegratedGradients", "GradientShap", "Both"),
  safetensors = FALSE,
  extra_args = character(0),
  conda_env = "flexynesisenv",
  conda_path = NULL
)

Arguments

data_path

Folder holding train/ and test/ (see export_flexynesis_data with layout = "train_test").

omic_list

Character vector of omics layer names; becomes --data_types and must match the CSV file names.

surv_time, surv_event

Column names in clin.csv for survival time and event indicator.

outdir

Output folder for flexynesis results.

model_class

flexynesis model class. Default "DirectPred". With surv_time/surv_event set, the DL models (DirectPred, supervised_vae, MultiTripletNetwork, CrossModalPred, GNN) attach an MLP head trained with Cox-PH loss, so they predict survival risk scores directly.

prefix

Job prefix for output files. Default "job".

threads

Number of CPU threads. Default 10.

device

"cpu", "mps", "cuda" or "auto".

use_cv

Logical; request 5-fold cross-validation.

variance_threshold, correlation_threshold, features_top_percentile, features_min

Feature-selection controls. Defaults (0, 1, 100, 0) keep every feature, i.e. no selection. features_top_percentile = 100 (not 0) is used on purpose: 0 makes older flexynesis skip the selection log and crash with KeyError: 'select_features', whereas 100 keeps all features via the Laplacian early-return. Override only if you want flexynesis to filter.

subsample

Training downsample size; 0 (default) keeps every patient.

finetuning_samples

Test samples used for fine-tuning; 0 (default) off.

feature_importance_method

Captum explainer for marker discovery: "IntegratedGradients" (default), "GradientShap" or "Both". Marker finding is left enabled so the importance CSV(s) are written.

safetensors

Logical; save as SafeTensors + JSON instead of .pth + .joblib.

extra_args

Optional character vector of additional raw CLI tokens.

conda_env, conda_path

Conda environment / binary.

Value

Invisibly a list of output paths: model, artifacts, predicted_labels, feature_importance (character vector of the importance CSV(s) actually written).
